We're doing a fit-out plan for a woodworking shop and need a render for next month's client and inspector review, so recreate the whole shop from this photo. Hero's the foreground white birch-ply folding bench: hardboard top with a dog-hole grid, splayed perforated legs, blue vise, plus leg-hung clamps and yellow blocks. Behind it, the log-mosaic-faced long bench with its track saw, blue drill press and CNC gantry router; then the wall-side lumber rack and cast-iron stove, rest per the photo. Keep the plywood/MDF look, size by proportion, warm overhead plus lamp light. Main thing: the equipment layout must read clearly, with edge room for callouts. Send a render and keep the .blend.
